verdict.rationale: Skyvern is driven by natural language throughout: tasks take a natural-language goal prompt, Copilot chat builds agents from a plain description, SOP upload turns plain-English processes into workflows, and the SDK offers natural-language act/extract/validate commands. A hands-on report confirms it works on the happy path but struggled to complete steps on a more complex site, which is a reliability caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent evidence that natural-language commands work reliably on complex, unfamiliar sites.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You provide a natural-language prompt describing the goal, a starting URL, and optionally a JSON schema for structured output.
Describe the job to Copilot at app.skyvern.com. It builds an agent you can test, edit in Studio, schedule and share. No code.
SOP upload — describe a process in plain English and Skyvern builds the workflow
Use natural language to act, extract, and validate — or fall back to selectors.
Skyvern opens a real browser and does the work you describe: logging in, filling forms, downloading files and pulling data.
